title: AI-assisted macaque claustrum atlas links cell types with projection zones
summary: Learned segmentation and Spatial-ID annotation helped connect macaque claustral cell-type distributions with four projection zones identified through tracer experiments. Different glutamatergic compositions preferentially connected to different brain regions. This is the April 3, 2025 journal version, preceded by a related 2024 conference abstract; comparisons reuse published macaque-cortex data, and the findings do not establish a causal account of consciousness.
organization: Chinese Academy of Sciences; Stem Cell and Brain Research Institute, Inserm; BGI-Research; Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab

evidence.tested: Spatial transcriptomics and retrograde tracing directly supported the cell-type/projection-zone relationship within the discovery study.
evidence.unknown: Not assessed: independent replication, complete supplements and exact first posting day of the earlier conference abstract.
evidence.ai_role: Mask R-CNN segments cells; Spatial-ID trains DNN and GCN models for spatial labels; expert-corrected nnUNet segments claustral boundaries.
